name: localix
description: Open source Agentic Development Environment: one workspace where you and a team of agents share the editor, terminals, preview, and databases.

scripts.build:desktop: bunx turbo build --filter=@localixai/api && cd apps/desktop-tauri && bun run tauri:build
scripts.release:desktop: bunx turbo build --filter=@localixai/api && cd apps/desktop-tauri && bun run tauri:release
scripts.test: bunx turbo test --concurrency=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-50%} && bun run test:repo

scripts.lint:react-doctor: oxlint -c config/oxlint-react-doctor.json apps/api/src apps/desktop-tauri/scripts apps/landing/src apps/ui/src packages plugins scripts
scripts.check:globals: TEST_GLOBALS_STRICT=1 bun test apps/api/src/features apps/ui/src packages
